implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide multiple strands of text for the player to combine
implemented_requirements.evidence: The repository defines a Puzzle dataclass that expects a list of strands, but no concrete puzzle instance or sample data is supplied in any file.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Verify that a selected set of strands forms a valid target word
implemented_requirements.evidence: StrandsGame.attempt_merge builds the merged string and calls Puzzle.word_for_strands to check if it matches a target word.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Confirm puzzle completion when all strands have been used
implemented_requirements.evidence: StrandsGame.check_completion marks the puzzle solved when used_strands length equals the total number of strands.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide feedback on successful merges (and other states)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Feedback and FeedbackType are used throughout attempt_merge, undo, hint, etc., returning appropriate messages.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Offer a playable interface (command loop / UI)
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.py only defines a Colors class; there is no command‑parsing loop, input handling, or entry‑point to start a game.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Name the game/puzzle "Strands" and expose core classes
implemented_requirements.evidence: Modules and classes are named StrandsGame, Puzzle, and the overall concept is documented as "Strands".

critical_issues: No concrete puzzle data (strands and target words) is provided, so the program cannot be run as a complete game.
ui.py lacks any interactive command loop or main function; the user cannot actually play the puzzle.
Colors.BOLD contains a typo ("\033[083[1m"), which would break color output if used.
No top‑level script or entry point to launch the game, reducing the likelihood of immediate execution.
judge.summary: The core logic for strand merging, validation, and feedback is implemented and well‑structured, but the repository is missing essential pieces required for a functional Strands puzzle: concrete puzzle definitions and a runnable user interface. Consequently, the solution does not meet the full benchmark and is rated as a fail.
